requirement_conflicts.prd_statement: compact dual-slot GPU within the confirmed 180 x 115 x 40 mm concept envelope
requirement_conflicts.observed_state: The selected Colorful GeForce RTX 3060 NB DUO 12G V3 L-V is officially 253.4 x 132.5 x 41.0 mm, dual-fan and 2-slot. Enclosure revision 292 still publishes a 180 x 115 x 40 mm single-fan GPU reference. Its latent 253.4 mm length audit leaves only about 0.6 mm to the front inner wall, while the front-panel cradle provides only about 0.5 mm clearance per side for the 41 mm card and overlaps the inverted card's far-end lower-edge power-connector region.
requirement_conflicts.resolution_reason: 锁定 Colorful GeForce RTX 3060 NB DUO 12G V3 L-V，并把机箱外深调整为 260 mm；重建真实双风扇参考、120 mm 双槽后开口、前托架和倒置 8-pin 避让。
